findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

The hand sink by the drive thru and the hand sink by the three part sink were observed with gaps forming around the edges. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-seal the locations prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all surfaces in the food preparation and cleaning areas are maintained in a smooth and easily cleanable state to facilitate effective cleaning.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: ... (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

Employees are observed to wash hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet during this inspection. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to trickle down the needed information. They should also be monitoring the hand washing practices in the facility to ensure that they are being conducted correctly at all times. Ensure proper hand washing takes place at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD.

1) Employees are observed to not wash hands prior to donning gloves. 2) Employees are observed to change tasks without hand washing or changing gloves. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to re-educate employees about glove changing and hand washing practices. They should also be aware of ongoing practices and enforce safe practices. Ensure hand washing is taking place WHEN it should be in the facility.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(B) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations.

A tray used for hot holding cooked chicken prior to service is observed with encrusted grease deposits and in use. The inspector scraped their fingernail on the item to ensure that it was encrusted grease and not a stain. The PIC was shown and instructed to scrub the trays in order to provide a smooth and easily cleanable (as well as clean) surface for food contact moving forward. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained free of encrusted grease and other contaminants in the facility at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

The space above the fries/tater tots hot holding station is heavily soiled with food debris and oil. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward. Ensure that all physical facilities are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. 

Multiple food handlers are observed to wash their hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to re-educate employees as to proper hand washing procedures.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

On arrival two of the hand sinks around the food preparation areas are without a hand drying device. Paper towels were supplied to correct. Ensure that hand sinks are maintained effectively supplied at all times.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. 

Multiple wiping cloths are observed on counters throughout the facility. Education was conducted and the cloths moved to their buckets to correct. Ensure that all wiping cloths are stored between uses in solution of sufficient concentration to maintain them sanitized.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The sani buckets at the front of the facility are observed not showing on inspector test strips. The buckets were remade to correct the violation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The nozzles of the fountain drink machines are heavily soiled and in need of cleaning. The PIC was shown one as an example and instructed to clean them all. They were cleaned during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. 

Multiple tongs hanging above the three part sink are observed with grease and food debris still on them. Ensure that all food contact items are cleaned thoroughly prior to storage. The tongs were moved back to the “dirty” pile for re-cleaning to correct.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. 

A moist wiping cloth is observed on a counter to the right of the fryer station. Ensure that all wiping cloths are stored between uses in solution. The rag was placed back in solution to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

Food debris observed throughout the facility behind equipment at floor/wall junction. Areas of specific note include behind the fryers, on top of the fry hot holding unit and under the shelves in the walk in cooler. Clean routinely to prevent accumulation and reduce the chances of pests.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Water observed pooling under the racks near the dry storage/desk area. Floor appears to slope away from the drain located near the desk. Make necessary adjustments/repairs to prevent water from ponding.
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. [C]
